title: LOOP_V0 iteration_record
description: One row of memory/loop_memory.jsonl. Today's hello-world has a minimal required set; Part 2 lands the full chain (hypothesis, retrieval, novelty, critique fields).

hypothesis.description: Populated by Part 2's hypothesize worker. Absent in hello-world.

retrieval.description: Populated by Part 2's retrieve_literature. Absent in hello-world.

novelty.description: Populated by Part 2's novelty_classify. Absent in hello-world.

critique.description: Populated by Part 2's critic_loop_v0. Absent in hello-world.

experiment_outcome.description: Populated when this iteration was bridged from a Tier-1/Tier-2 sandbox experiment (e.g., exp003 Vickrey-rediscovery). Carries the cross-tier evidence into the literature loop. Absent for pure-Tier-3 iterations.

experiment_id.description: Identifier for the experiment that produced this outcome, e.g. 'exp003_vickrey_rediscovery'.

metric.description: Name of the primary measured quantity, e.g. 'truthful_bid_fraction'.

value.description: Primary measured value. Scalar for single-metric outcomes; object for multi-metric.

results_path.description: Repo-relative path to the experiment's results file (e.g., experiments/exp003_vickrey_rediscovery/results/summary.md).

redteam.description: Loop v1 Step 2.5. Populated by the orchestrator-driven red-team retry sub-loop (workers/redteam_critic). Optional; absent for pre-v1 rows.

meta_review.description: Loop v1 Step 1.5. Conditioning synthesis from prior loop memory (workers/meta_review), injected into the iteration's initial user message. Optional; absent for pre-v1 rows and when meta_review degrades.

gate_status.description: Loop v1 Step 8. Human-gate state for this iteration. Set to 'pending' at finalize; a human verdict written via orchestrator.gate_cli to memory/loop_feedback.jsonl carries the resolution.

cross_tier_comparison.description: Loop v1 Step 5. Cross-mechanism replication comparison (experiments/replication_driver). Optional; present only when an iteration was bridged from a replication run.

nara_summary.description: Final assistant message from Nara summarizing the iteration.

tool_calls_made.description: Tool names invoked in order. Must include 'journal_writer_stub' (or in Part 2: 'journal_writer').

narration_log.description: Per-turn narration Nara emitted before each tool call. Optional for hello-world; populated when present.

wrapper_call_ids.description: request_ids of every wrapper call this iteration produced.
